finding: Coalesced tag construction reduces operand stores and improves many ARM-host non-x86 paths, but 53 of 264 native panels regress by more than one percent. GCC PE32 detail loses about 4.5 percent in the fixed-image launch; Clang14/18 also have regressions. Hold the candidate.
root_cause_evidence: GCC13 creates 1299 physical direct-transfer sites to the new MCOperand_initReg/Imm helpers. The frozen PE32 formatting workload executes 34287 such transfers in three traversals, adding helper call/return work. Both Clang builds have no such outlined helpers. This demonstrates a specific GCC lowering defect in the prototype; it does not explain all reader inlining or all native timing differences.
portable_recovery: Initial all-backend Clang/GCC jobs passed units and fixtures, then failed the object-scope assertion because the scope omitted RISCVInstPrinter.c. Its included RISCVGenCompressedInstructionsInfo.inc invokes the changed constructors during uncompressInst. Two repaired configurations passed with the identical candidate tree. The final nine-profile coverage combines seven successful initial configurations and these two reruns; initial failure evidence and cleanup are retained.
limits: All nine A/A flags retained; 21-cycle bootstrap intervals are descriptive without multiplicity correction. All 23 backends build on Linux Clang/GCC, but fixture coverage is limited to existing MC directories and units. Six x87 hardware executions are skipped on Windows/macOS. ASan/UBSan exact-source semantic tests pass; sanitizer object identity is not asserted. Iced and current NeverD product qualification were not run after this failed performance screen.
